transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Hi, saw your Pearl Residences post. Looking for own stay with family. Can share more?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Hi! Pearl Residences is a freehold residential condominium in Seberang Jaya. The plans also include an approximately 10-acre elevated landscaped facilities deck. For your family’s own stay, what would you most like to know first—layouts, facilities, or the surrounding area?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Layouts first, please. Do you have a 3-bedroom option around 900 sqft? We’re a family of four, so I’m trying to work out if it would feel cramped.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Yes—Pearl Residences has a Type A layout at 900 sq ft, with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. I don’t have verified room dimensions or the floorplan to share right now, so I’ll check those for you. Room sizes will help you judge whether it works for your family.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks, yes, the room dimensions would help—especially whether the smaller bedrooms can fit a proper bed and study desk. Could you send the floorplan when you’ve checked?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Absolutely—I’ll check for the verified Type A floorplan and room dimensions, especially for fitting a bed and study desk in the smaller bedrooms. I don’t want to guess on the fit, so I’ll share them once confirmed.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks. We’re renting at the moment, so just trying to work out if 900 sq ft is practical before we go further. Any idea when you might have the floorplan?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: I don’t have a confirmed timeframe yet, so I don’t want to guess. I’ll check and share the verified floorplan and room dimensions once I have them, so you can assess whether it works for your family.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Alright, please check and send it when you can. Is there a show unit we could view in the meantime? It’s hard to picture whether the bedrooms will work from the floor area alone.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: I can’t confirm yet whether a show unit is available. I’ll check the viewing arrangements, and follow up with the verified floorplan and room dimensions too.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks. Weekend viewing would be easiest for both of us, if a show unit is available. Please let me know once you’ve checked, and send the floorplan when you have it.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Understood—weekend works best for you both. I’ll check whether a show unit is available and whether a weekend viewing can be arranged, and follow up with that and the verified floorplan and room dimensions once confirmed.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks, appreciate it. We both commute around Seberang Jaya, so the location could work for us. Could you also check the monthly maintenance fee? We’re trying to work out the overall costs.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: The maintenance fee is RM0.18 per sq ft per month, inclusive of sinking fund. For a 900 sq ft unit, that works out to about RM162 per month. I’m still checking the verified floorplan and whether a weekend show-unit viewing can be arranged.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks, that’s helpful. Does the RM162 cover use of the facilities, or are there any other regular charges we should factor in? Please keep me posted on the floorplan and weekend viewing too.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: The RM162 is the monthly maintenance fee, including sinking fund. Use of selected clubhouse facilities is pay-per-use, so it isn’t included in that fixed fee. I can’t confirm any other regular charges yet, so I’ll check rather than guess. I’ll also follow up on the verified floorplan and whether a weekend show-unit viewing can be arranged.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Got it, thanks. Could you check which facilities are pay-per-use and what the rates are, along with any other regular charges? Please update us on the floorplan and weekend viewing when you’ve confirmed those too.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: I don’t have verified rates or a confirmed list of other regular charges yet, so I won’t guess. I’ll follow up with those details, along with the verified floorplan and whether a weekend show-unit viewing can be arranged.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Alright, thanks. We’ll wait for the details before deciding about a visit—just message me once you’ve confirmed them.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Of course—I’ll message you once I’ve confirmed the floorplan and room dimensions, weekend viewing arrangements, pay-per-use facilities and rates, and any other regular charges. No need to decide about a visit until then.
